name: Hume AI
summary: Voice AI company offering emotion-aware models and evaluation tools for voice systems.
description: Hume AI works on emotionally intelligent voice AI. Its current focus is infrastructure to evaluate voice systems: it finds conversations that break a system, diagnoses why and feeds failures into an improvement loop, combining automated evaluation and human judgment. Its Expression APIs measure more than 600 dimensions of vocal and facial expression in over 50 languages. No public prices were shown on the pricing page during this check.

howToUse.title: Open Hume AI
howToUse.description: Open Hume AI and choose Evaluate your system, or Talk to Hume. No public prices were shown on the pricing page.

howToUse.title: Evaluate the voice system
howToUse.description: Point the evaluation at a voice system. Hume finds the conversations that break that system, diagnoses why, and feeds each failure into an improvement loop that combines automated evaluation and human judgment.

howToUse.title: Measure vocal and facial expression
howToUse.description: Open the Expression APIs and measure expression. They cover more than 600 dimensions of vocal and facial expression in over 50 languages.

howToUse.title: Generate tests and validate the change
howToUse.description: Follow the loop shown on the page: generate targeted tests, stress-test the voice system, diagnose the failures, and validate the improvement.
